about: CHK-13 (R-13): the reviewed inventory of script files that name a database client: a driver specifier in any form, a client command (psql, pg_dump, pg_dumpall, pg_restore, pgcli, createdb, dropdb), or DATABASE_URL. Each has a kind that scripts/ci/own-database-client.test.mjs enforces: launcher and contract construct no client and run no client command; read-only runs its statement through runReadOnlyReport; probe runs only select 1; container-local runs only the read-only probe psql -c 'select 1' inside a local container through docker exec; pinned-read-probe is a reviewed read probe pinned byte for byte by its hash in the rules module; owner-operation is the one pinned owner operation, and only its pinned modules stand under another entry; residual is a disposable-database writer that has not yet moved behind the guarded client. Every other destructive script takes its client from the guarded import behind assertDisposableTarget.
